summary: Zcash 的 Orchard 池曝出漏洞，以太坊社区讨论隐私系统中漏洞难以察觉的问题，ameensol 建议用户退出 Orchard 池以检验是否被利用。lightclient 提醒 EIP-8037 已排入 Glamsterdam，新建账户和写入新存储槽的 gas 将上升 5 到 8 倍，征集可能受影响的协议。EIP-8130 完成整理定稿和修订。ERC-8290 提出在 UTXO 隐私协议之间直接转移屏蔽票据。

image.credit_en: Ethereum Magicians, ERC-8290: Shielded Note Teleportation

summary_en: A bug surfaced in Zcash's Orchard pool, and the Ethereum community discussed how hard bugs are to detect in privacy systems; ameensol suggested users exit the Orchard pool to test whether it was exploited. lightclient noted that EIP-8037 is scheduled for Glamsterdam and will raise the gas cost of creating accounts and writing new storage slots by 5 to 8x, and asked which protocols might be affected. EIP-8130 got a finalize pass and fixes. ERC-8290 proposes moving shielded notes directly between UTXO privacy protocols.
